components.name: Primary Button (Ink)
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #14161a; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(20,22,26,0.85); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3654d6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Advisor chat 'Ask' submit button — the accent's one filled-button use.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background: #3654d6; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #2743b3; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2743b3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Three-tone pill: stale / error / flag. The system's only filled semantic-color primitive.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; } .ds-chip-flag { background: #eef1fc; color: #2743b3; } .ds-chip-stale { background: #fbf1dc; color: #92640a; } .ds-chip-error { background: #fbecec; color: #a83f3f; }

components.name: Card (Surface)
components.description: Top-level bordered container — portfolio summary, holdings list, empty/error states.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e6e5e1; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px 28px; } .ds-card-eyebrow { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #5b6068; margin: 0; } .ds-card-figure { font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1; color: #14161a; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin: 6px 0 0; }

components.name: P&L Value
components.description: Gain/loss display: neutral ink + directional glyph, never red/green. Compliance-driven — see DESIGN.md Colors > Named Rules.
components.css: .ds-pnl { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-pnl-glyph { font-size: 0.65em; color: #6b7280; } .ds-pnl-amount { font-weight: 500; color: #14161a; } .ds-pnl-pct { color: #5b6068; }

components.name: Holding Row
components.description: Expandable list row: avatar-initials, symbol/name, value/weight, P&L. Signature component of the holdings list.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 16px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e6e5e1; background: none; border-left: none; border-right: none; border-top: none; text-align: left; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-row:hover { background: rgba(247,247,245,0.6); } .ds-row-avatar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #f7f7f5; color: #5b6068; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-row-name strong { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #14161a; } .ds-row-name small { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #6b7280; } .ds-row-value { margin-left: auto; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #14161a; } .ds-row-value small { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; color: #6b7280; }

components.name: Advisor Trigger
components.description: Floating action button opening the advisor drawer — the one shadowed in-flow element.
components.css: .ds-fab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #14161a; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 16px; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(20,22,26,0.10); transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-fab:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3654d6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.html: Financial Modeling Prep · as of Jul 29, 6:00 AM EDT

narrative.overview: Rundown is the category standard, executed at full commitment: a consumer-fintech portfolio dashboard in the register of Robinhood, Copilot Money, and Wealthfront, deliberately chosen over two invented visual worlds (a newsroom rundown sheet, an airport split-flap board) during the direction pass recorded in PRODUCT.md. There is no named metaphor here by design — the brief was to play the convention straight, not to smuggle a quirk into it. The system reads as calm, trustworthy, and slightly clinical: neutral paper-and-ink surfaces, one restrained accent, confident tabular numerals, and generous card padding, closer to a well-made banking app than to a trading terminal. The one place this system departs hardest from category convention is deliberate, not accidental: gain/loss is never color-coded red or green. This is a compliance-grounded rule, not a taste preference. Rundown is light-mode only for now, chosen from the use-scene stated in the surface brief.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral paper/ink palette with a single blue-indigo accent, used sparingly (links, the advisor's brand touches, one chip tone)
A second, structurally separate status-color pair (amber for stale, red for error) reserved exclusively for data freshness — never repurposed for gain/loss
Flat, bordered cards at rest; shadow appears only on floating/overlay elements (the advisor drawer and its trigger)
Tabular numerals everywhere a number appears in a column or is compared across rows
Every provider-sourced data point carries a source · as of [timestamp] line, rendered in the same faint, low-emphasis type

rules.name: The Neutral P&L Rule
rules.body: Gain/loss is never rendered in red or green. It is always neutral ink (#14161a for the figure, #5b6068 for the percent) with a small ▲/▼ glyph in ink-faint. This is a compliance boundary, not a stylistic restraint — see components/PnlValue.tsx's own comment and CLAUDE.md hard rule 1.

rules.name: The Two-Color-System Rule
rules.body: The accent (#3654d6 family) and the status pair (amber/red) never cross roles. Accent means brand/interactive/flagged-for-attention; status means how much to trust this data right now.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Any number a user might scan down a column or compare across rows renders with tabular-nums. No numeric column may use proportional figures.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces embedded in page flow never carry a shadow. Shadow only appears on elements that overlay the page (modals, drawers, floating triggers).

dos: Do render gain/loss in neutral ink with a ▲/▼ glyph only — never red or green (components/PnlValue.tsx).
Do apply tabular-nums to every number that appears in a column or is compared row-to-row.
Do attach a {source} · as of {timestamp} line to any value fetched from a provider, using formatAsOf for timestamped values.

Do format date-only values (no time-of-day component, e.g. a filing date) with formatDate's explicit timeZone: "UTC" — a bare YYYY-MM-DD string parses as UTC midnight, and formatting it in the viewer's local zone can roll it back a day west of UTC. Don't remove the timeZone: "UTC" option.
Do use the paper/surface tonal step (not a border) to distinguish content nested inside a card.
Do keep shadows reserved for overlay elements (drawer, floating trigger) and flat borders for everything in normal page flow.
donts: Don't color-code P&L red/green, or otherwise let a visual treatment read as implicit buy/sell guidance — this is a legal boundary (Investment Advisers Act, CLAUDE.md hard rule 1), not a style call.
Don't reuse the status-color pair (amber/red) for anything other than data freshness or fetch errors. It must never double as a gain/loss or sentiment color.
Don't ship a data point without a source and as-of timestamp, even in a compact or secondary UI placement.
Don't introduce a second accent hue. The system's Restrained color strategy means one accent, used sparingly.
Don't design new screens against dark mode yet; the system is light-mode only by a deliberate use-scene decision, not an oversight.
